title: Pro-p Sylow Theory for Profinite Groups

problemStatement.formal: For a profinite group G and prime p, there exist maximal pro-p closed subgroups (Sylow pro-p subgroups), and all such subgroups are conjugate.
problemStatement.plain: Generalize the Sylow theorems from finite groups to profinite groups (compact, Hausdorff, totally disconnected topological groups).
whyMatters: Foundational for Galois cohomology and class field theory
Controls p-adic representations via absolute Galois group
Bridges finite and infinite group theory

proven: Serre (1965): existence and conjugacy of Sylow pro-p subgroups
open: Full inverse limit construction in Lean 4
Lazard's theorem for pro-p groups of finite rank
knownResults.goal: Formalize pro-p Sylow theory with definitions, axioms, and proved consequences

knowledge.progressSummary: COMPLETE: 298-line formalization with 7 proved theorems, 5 axioms, 1 sorry
insights: TopologicalGroup causes binder issues; use continuous_mul + continuous_inv
Axiom declarations don't inherit section variables in Lean 4
